description: Y4KCam (Yale 4K x 4K Camera) was an optical imager mounted on the SMARTS 1.0-meter (formerly Yale 1m) telescope at CTIO, utilizing a 4096x4096 CCD and standard broad-band optical filters.
facility_description: The SMARTS 1.0-meter telescope is located at Cerro Tololo Inter-American Observatory (CTIO) in Chile, operated by the SMARTS consortium.
notes: Y4KCam operated on the 1.0m telescope. Curves from OSU/SMARTS lack explicit open redistribution licences.
